Section 1: This Board declares a moratorium on the issuance and processing of any
permits for the development of any type of data center, or related use, within Painesville
Township for a period of twelve (12) months from the effective date hereof, or such other period
as may be approved by the Board of Trustees of Painesville Township based upon the results of
any studies conducted or submitted to it.
